connect.title: Add Smrit
connect.text: Open Settings, then MCP servers, then Add server. Choose Streamable HTTP. Name it {{server_name}} and paste this URL.

connect.title: Save and authenticate
connect.text: Save, select Restart, then Authenticate beside Smrit. Type /mcp in the composer to check the server is available.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Add a small memory instruction
instructions.text: Open Settings and your personal instructions. Append this to the existing text. If you manage instructions as files, use the active global AGENTS.override.md or AGENTS.md in your Codex home.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Add a custom MCP server
connect.text: Open ChatGPT Plugins. Select the plus button, then Add custom MCP server. Use Smrit as the name and Shared memory for agents as the description.

connect.title: Create and install the plugin
connect.text: Enter this URL as the public endpoint, choose OAuth, review the access notice and create the plugin. Install it and confirm its tools are available. Workspace policy may require an administrator.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Add a small memory instruction
instructions.text: Open Settings, Personalization, then Custom instructions. Append the text below. Make sure the Smrit plugin is available in the new conversation; local desktop MCP settings do not carry over to the web.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Add the connection
connect.text: Run these commands on the machine where Codex runs. The desktop app and IDE share this host configuration.
connect.value:
codex mcp add {{server_name}} --url {{mcp_url}}
codex mcp login {{server_name}} --scopes read,write

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

connect.title: Check the tools
connect.text: Start a new session. Use /mcp in the CLI or the MCP servers list in the IDE to check authentication. Keep existing servers; do not replace your config file.

instructions.title: Use the global instruction file
instructions.text: Append this to AGENTS.md in CODEX_HOME, normally ~/.codex. If a nonempty AGENTS.override.md exists there, append to that active file instead. Project instructions can override it.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Add a custom connector
connect.text: Open Customize, Connectors, then Add and Add custom connector. Name it Smrit and paste this URL.

connect.title: Choose automatic registration
connect.text: When asked how to register the OAuth client, choose Register automatically. Continue, review the connection and choose Sign in now. On a managed workspace, an owner may need to add it first.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

connect.title: Make it available
connect.text: In a new conversation, use the plus menu and Connectors to enable Smrit.

instructions.title: Use your Claude instructions
instructions.text: Open Settings, Your Claude, then Instructions. Append the text below. These are your personal instructions, separate from a project’s instructions.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Add Smrit for your user
connect.text: If Smrit is already available through your Claude connectors, reuse it. Otherwise run this on the machine where Claude Code runs.

connect.title: Authenticate
connect.text: In Claude Code, open /mcp, select Smrit and follow the sign-in flow.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Use your global instruction file
instructions.text: Append this to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, or update only the Smrit section if it already exists. That file applies in every project.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve the rest of the file and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Add a connector
connect.text: Open grok.com/connectors, select New Connector and choose a custom MCP connection. Paste this URL.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

connect.title: Enable the tools
connect.text: Check that Smrit is enabled for the conversation. Workspace controls and available settings can differ by account.

instructions.title: Add to custom instructions
instructions.text: In Grok settings, open your custom instructions and append this text. Save it, then use a new conversation to check that it applies.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Add the MCP server
connect.text: Run this where Grok Build runs. Follow the browser authentication flow when it opens.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Use your global rules
instructions.text: Append this to ~/.grok/AGENTS.md. Keep any existing rules. Start a new session; grok inspect can show which rules were loaded.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Connect on the actual gateway
connect.text: In the Control UI, open Settings, MCP. Add a Streamable HTTP server named {{server_name}} using this URL.

connect.title: Enable and sign in
connect.text: Enable Smrit for the agent you use and complete OAuth in the Control UI. Adding a global server does not enable it in every session.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

connect.title: If you use the CLI
connect.text: Add the server on the gateway host. CLI OAuth login is an offline path: stop the gateway before openclaw mcp login, then restart it. Prefer the Control UI when the gateway is running.

instructions.title: Use the agent’s workspace instructions
instructions.text: Append this to AGENTS.md in the selected agent’s workspace. Each agent has its own workspace. Keep its persona in SOUL.md and preserve all existing instructions.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.

connect.title: Merge into your MCP configuration
connect.text: In the active profile’s config.yaml, normally ~/.hermes/config.yaml, merge this server under mcp_servers. Preserve existing servers.

connect.title: Authenticate on the Hermes host
connect.text: Run this from a fresh terminal, then restart Hermes or use /reload-mcp. A remote gateway needs authentication on that host.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Create a small native skill
instructions.text: Save this as skills/smrit-memory/SKILL.md inside the active Hermes profile, normally ~/.hermes. Preserve any existing Smrit skill or update its bootstrap section.
instructions.value:
---
name: smrit-memory
description: Recall shared context and capture authorized outcomes through Smrit.
---

{{instructions}}

instructions.title: Load it in every session
instructions.text: Add smrit-memory to skills.auto_load in the same profile’s config.yaml. Merge with the existing list. Keep the skill enabled on the platforms you use. Start a new session.

connect.title: Ask your bot to add Smrit
connect.text: Send this to the bot you want to use.
connect.value: Add a custom MCP app named {{server_name}} at {{mcp_url}}. Show me the connection card so I can authorize it.

connect.title: Authorize the connection
connect.text: Use Authorize or Authenticate on the connection card. Adding the app alone does not grant access. Its tools should be available on the next message.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Give your bot a lasting instruction
instructions.text: Send this in chat and check that the bot confirms it saved the instruction. This applies to this bot, not every bot. Shared bots may need their owner to configure instructions.
instructions.value:
Save this as a lasting instruction for this bot, preserving my other instructions:

{{instructions}}

connect.title: Add Smrit for every project
connect.text: Run this on the machine where OpenCode V2 runs. It merges the server into your global configuration.

connect.title: Authenticate
connect.text: Run this command or open /mcps, select Smrit and sign in. If you configure it by hand, V2 uses mcp.servers, not the V1 mcp structure.

connect.title: Approve your account
connect.text: Sign in to Smrit and check {{org_name}} before approving. To save memories, allow read and write access. Read-only access can recall existing context but cannot save new outcomes.

instructions.title: Use your user instruction file
instructions.text: Append this to ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md. Preserve existing instructions and resolve any conflicting project rules. Check with a fresh session in your usual project.

instructions.title: Keep your existing instructions
instructions.text: Add this as a small separate section. Preserve your other rules and any explicit account binding for a project. Start a new conversation after saving.
